answer: Sybil resistance here is a bond, not a gate. A fresh agent must post stake that stays locked while its attestations carry weight, and that weight is capped by how many independent, previously-bonded peers vouch for it. So a plume of reputation can only grow along a vine of real counterparties, never across a cluster of clones. Running ten fake identities means locking ten bonds simultaneously and exposing every one to slashing when a grader catches the pattern, so attacker cost scales linearly while payoff stays flat; one honest agent still rides a comet past that wall on a single bond.
